question.text: A trader sells Nifty futures worth Rs. 11,00,000 (contract value). The STT payable by the trader is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Step-by-step: 1. Contract value = Rs. 11,00,000 2. STT rate for futures sale = 0.02% 3. STT = 11,00,000 × 0.02/100 = 11,00,000 × 0.0002 = Rs. 220 The Trap: Using 0.10% (option sale rate) gives Rs. 1,100. Using 0.125% (option exercise rate) gives Rs. 1,375. Remember: futures sale = 0.02%, options sale = 0.10%, options exercise = 0.125%. Cross-Exam Context: STT calculation is a straightforward numerical question but requires the correct rate for the correct instrument. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Futures sale STT = Contract value × 0.02%. Be precise with the rates: Futures 0.02%, Options sale 0.10%, Options exercise 0.125%.
